name: banner
description: The landmark holding a page's own furniture: the site identity and whatever sits beside it at the top of every screen. There is no APG pattern page for it, since landmarks are a practice and not a widget, so the landmark-regions practice page is the pattern's source, the way it is for navigation. One per page, which is why no name is required: a reader jumping by landmark reaches it by its role.

requires.roles.element: banner (native header at the top level of the document, or role=banner when header cannot be used)
